summary: FAIL_NOT_READY: PR-171 is process-authorized by the explicit approved sequence, but it remains an internal roadmap_rescue_v1:C2 hypothesis_only artifact with public_use=false. Implementation must not begin from the current prose because the roadmap leaks a proposed 1e-6..1e-7 numerical conclusion contrary to the current pre-result freeze contract, and the supplied evidence does not yet bind an authenticated source-attribution record or a total terminal-routing schema. A remediated spec may proceed without promoting the lane.
steelman: A properly frozen PR-171 can be a meaningful honesty result: it can test one exact dynamical class, attribute the inherited tilt-decay mechanism externally, quantify only a preregistered suppression functional, and close reproducibly with a class-conditional result, a physically admissible counterexample that retires the proposed no-go, algebraic_only, non_informative, CAS_BLOCKED, CAS_CONFLICT, or CAS_FAIL. The explicit execution authorization and persistent-tilt kill switch make that narrow lane schedulable even though its scientific artifact mode stays hypothesis_only.

claim_results.rationale: The claim ceiling and public-use quarantine are conceptually sound, but the proposal is not yet safe to implement: the literal suppression target in the roadmap conflicts with the current shared contract, external attribution is named but not authenticated in the supplied evidence, and the terminal state machine must be frozen before any CAS or numerical result is viewed.

findings.title: The roadmap fixes a numerical target before the suppression functional is sealed

evidence.supports: The roadmap directs production of Pi_X/momentum-source below 1e-6..1e-7 and asks for a ceiling number.

The current authoritative PR-171 boundary requires the class, variables, closure, ODE, subsystem, target, functional, and falsifier to be frozen before results and forbids fixing any numerical suppression conclusion, explicitly including 1e-6.

findings.analysis: The roadmap value is a proposed hypothesis, not an admissible expected answer, acceptance threshold, test oracle, caption number, or result-card default. Carrying it into a spec or test would make a later calculation self-confirming. The PR-171 spec must supersede it for execution and interpretation while preserving the roadmap bytes through an explicit erratum or non-reuse statement if those bytes are immutable.
findings.required_remediation: Freeze the dimensioned or dimensionless suppression functional, normalization, time interval or asymptotic limit, initial-condition class, equation-of-state domain, closure, and evaluation parameters without an expected numerical result. State verbatim that any numerical ceiling is an output under the frozen class and is not a preregistered conclusion or universal bound.

findings.title: Execution authorization and scientific artifact status are deliberately orthogonal

evidence.supports: The card assigns COMMON ownership, BASS contribution, conditional C2 ceiling, hypothesis_only artifact mode, EXPLICIT_APPROVED_SEQUENCE authorization, and public_use=false.
Scheduler eligibility comes only from the explicit approved sequence and does not promote the hypothesis_only scientific lane.

findings.analysis: The apparent defensible execution lane is a scheduler field, not a scientific validation or publication field. COMMON may own the contract, harness, manifest, mutation report, semantic guards, and terminal adjudication. BASS may contribute pre-solver conventions and equation mapping, but must not label any output native. No HTT likelihood, posterior, evidence, PPC, or LOOCV and no MIO certificate belongs in this card.
findings.required_remediation: Make scheduler authorization, process status, scientific status, artifact mode, claim tier, and public-use status separate required fields. Add mutations proving that changing hypothesis_only to standard_internal, public_use to true, or C2 to C3 is rejected even while execution remains authorized.

findings.title: Named attribution is not yet a source-provenance seal

evidence.supports: The roadmap names King-Ellis and Coley-Hervik-Lim and describes khronon dressing as a loophole.
The current contract requires external attribution of the Coley--Hervik--Lim mechanism and limits khronon or non-comoving dressing to a loophole or counterexample lane.

findings.analysis: Author names alone do not bind the exact equation, variable convention, time coordinate, dynamical class, equation-of-state interval, closure assumptions, or applicability of the cited result. No PR-171 primary-source record was supplied to this assignment, so this review does not validate the scientific attribution and does not infer whether such a file exists elsewhere in the repository.
findings.required_remediation: Before any axis result is viewed, authenticate each relied-on source byte set, record equation and page locators, freeze a symbol and convention crosswalk, and state separately what each source supports. Describe the repository work as a class-conditional audit or application of an externally attributed mechanism, never as a new tilt-decay theorem. Treat khronon and other non-comoving dressings only as registered loophole or counterexample candidates, never as assumed closure.

findings.title: The result contract needs total terminal routing and withheld positive targets on non-pass branches

evidence.supports: The card registers persistent-tilt retirement and CAS_BLOCKED for a missing axis, but does not itself encode the full result-state table.
Four blind axes are non-collapsible; persistent tilt retires the no-go; missing admissibility or closure may end algebraic_only, non_informative, blocked, or failed.
A computational four-axis agreement is not the final scientific adjudication when the contract is invalid.
CAS algebra remains algebraic_only when physical-promotion receipts are missing.
A missing Wolfram axis yields CAS_BLOCKED, no majority promotion, and withheld scalar targets while a source-provenance audit may remain reportable.

findings.analysis: A 2x2 eigenvalue calculation can at most establish the stability property encoded by the frozen linearized subsystem. It cannot by itself establish global relaxation, generic-fluid exclusion, physical admissibility, or a universal no-go. CAS agreement cannot manufacture missing source-space closure or physical premises. Every non-pass route must null or withhold the stability and suppression fields rather than preserve a stale candidate value.
findings.required_remediation: Freeze a closed terminal enum and route every combination of CAS state, contract validity, source closure, physical admissibility, and counterexample status. Require post-CAS scientific-contract review; a contract edit changes the hash and requires four fresh blind axes.

findings.title: Family, geometry, observational, and native-transfer promotions remain categorically out of scope

evidence.supports: External or AniCLASS transfer remains transfer-conditional, scalar or directional results cannot identify a family, and every result needs complete claim metadata.
Comparator identities do not certify FLRW, constrain global anisotropy, identify a family, or validate a native transfer.
The adjacent exact-mechanics card explicitly disclaims observational, family, geometry, native-transfer, and new-theorem claims.

findings.analysis: PR-171 consumes no sky, mask, null ensemble, covariance, atlas, native transfer, likelihood, posterior, or evidence term. Its transfer source must be none or not_applicable_exact_mechanics; an external paper is source provenance, not a transfer source. No class-conditional ODE result can identify a Bianchi family or prove isotropy.
findings.required_remediation: Encode the firewall in result-card schema, consumer scan, forbidden-claim lint, and live hostile mutations. If any result or caption gains observational, detection, isotropy, geometry, family, native-transfer, posterior, evidence, or public-use language, block the card.

required_wording: PR-171 is an internal roadmap_rescue_v1:C2 class-conditional ODE stability audit in scientific_artifact_mode=hypothesis_only, executed only under EXPLICIT_APPROVED_SEQUENCE; public_use=false; transfer_source=none.

COMMON owns the contract, harness, manifest, mutation report, semantic gates, and terminal adjudication; BASS is a pre-solver contributor only. The tilt-decay mechanism is externally attributed to the authenticated Coley--Hervik--Lim source record.

Within the frozen dynamical class, time variable, equation-of-state and closure domain, the registered 2x2 linearized subsystem has the reported stability state. This is a class-conditional linearized result, not a generic-fluid or global no-go theorem.
Khronon or non-comoving dark-sector dressing is evaluated only as a loophole or counterexample lane, not as assumed closure and not as a new theorem.

The suppression functional, normalization, evaluation interval or asymptotic limit, initial-condition class, and all parameters were frozen before any result. Any numerical value is an output under that frozen domain, not a preregistered conclusion, universal bound, or acceptance threshold.
A physically admissible persistent-tilt counterexample retires the proposed no-go claim; it is not reclassified as a harmless loophole while the no-go wording is retained.

This artifact does not prove isotropy, exclude persistent tilt outside the frozen class, identify a Bianchi family, detect anisotropic geometry, validate a native transfer, or support an observational, likelihood, posterior, evidence, cosmological, or detection claim.

terminal_routes.condition: One immutable schema-v2 contract receives CAS_4AXIS_PASS; post-CAS contract review passes; source provenance, exact class mapping, source-space closure, and physical-admissibility receipts pass; no registered physically admissible persistent-tilt counterexample survives.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: Only the exact stability state and any derived suppression output inside the frozen class and domain, with roadmap_rescue_v1:C2, hypothesis_only, and public_use=false.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No generic-fluid, global no-go, isotropy, family, geometry, native-transfer, observational, posterior, evidence, or detection claim.

terminal_routes.condition: A registered persistent-tilt construction passes every frozen physical-admissibility, same-state, source-space, and domain gate.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: The proposed class-conditional no-go is retired by the registered counterexample within its exact domain.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No positive no-go or suppression-ceiling claim may remain; do not demote the counterexample to a caveat.

terminal_routes.condition: CAS verifies algebra or eigenvalue identities but physical admissibility, same-state mapping, or externally authenticated source closure is incomplete.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: Exact algebraic or linear-system mechanics only.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No physical relaxation, no-go, source-space, or suppression claim.

terminal_routes.condition: The target source class, closure, suppression functional, or mapping to the claimed mechanism is not identifiable under the frozen evidence.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: A reproducible non-informative or source-closure-not-established result.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No stability direction, exclusion, or numerical ceiling inferred from absence of evidence.

terminal_routes.condition: Any required Wolfram+xAct, SymPy high-precision, SageMath+Singular, or Lean+mathlib axis is missing or platform-blocked.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: A process-blocked result and any independently authenticated source-provenance audit.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: All theorem, stability, eigenvalue, counterexample, and numerical suppression target fields must be null or WITHHELD_CAS_BLOCKED; no majority promotion.

terminal_routes.condition: Post-normalization axes disagree under one contract hash.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: A conflict result with a minimal-counterexample re-adjudication request.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No voting and no positive stability or suppression claim.

terminal_routes.condition: A valid axis counterexample or proof failure occurs, or post-CAS review finds the frozen contract inconsistent or underdefined.
terminal_routes.allowed_claim: A reproducible failure result; if and only if a failure is also a physically admissible persistent-tilt counterexample, route additionally to counterexample_retirement.
terminal_routes.withheld_or_forbidden: No reuse of PASS receipts after any contract repair; a new hash requires four fresh blind axes.

proposed_changes: Create a frozen PR-171 spec before any CAS or numerical result. Bind the exact dynamical class, state dimension, time variable, sign conventions, equation-of-state and closure domain, background ODE, 2x2 subsystem, local-versus-global stability target, suppression functional, admissibility receipts, falsifier, and total terminal enum.

Add a hash-bound interpretation erratum or supersession record stating that the roadmap's 1e-6..1e-7 literal is an unvalidated proposal and is not an expected result, acceptance threshold, or test oracle.

Create authenticated primary-source provenance with exact archive hashes, equation/page locators, source-specific supported claims, and a symbol/convention crosswalk. Keep Coley--Hervik--Lim attribution external and khronon/non-comoving dressing in the counterexample lane.
Keep COMMON as process and artifact owner and BASS as pre-solver contributor. Do not add HTT likelihood/evidence or MIO certificate ownership.

Make positive result fields nullable and require them to be withheld on algebraic_only, non_informative, CAS_BLOCKED, CAS_CONFLICT, CAS_FAIL, contract-invalid, or counterexample-retirement branches as applicable.

Add a claim mutation matrix that kills numerical precommitment, C2-to-C3 promotion, hypothesis_only removal, public_use=true, lost EoS or closure qualifiers, external-attribution removal, surviving no-go after a persistent-tilt counterexample, CAS majority promotion, and family/native/observational language.
Keep production and manuscript consumers at zero unless a later separately authorized card owns them; no figure is needed for this exact-mechanics claim gate.

Run live mutation tests for fixed 1e-6 expectation, generic-fluid wording, missing source attribution, missing EoS or closure qualifier, retained no-go after persistent tilt, public_use promotion, hypothesis_only removal, family/native language, and CAS_BLOCKED majority promotion.
Run the smallest relevant COMMON/BASS regression and smoke suites after implementation, then rerun the claim review against generated bytes rather than candidate prose.
risks_and_kill_switches: A physically admissible persistent-tilt counterexample immediately retires the proposed no-go and suppresses any positive ceiling claim.
A missing required CAS axis is CAS_BLOCKED; cost, timeout, license, or platform state is not a post-result computation-class exception.
A contract change after any axis result invalidates all old axis receipts for closeout and requires four fresh blind axes.
Missing source-space closure or physical admissibility forces algebraic_only or non_informative; CAS agreement cannot promote it.
A 2x2 local linear-stability result must not be described as global relaxation unless a separately frozen global obligation is actually proved.

Any hard-coded numerical answer, unqualified generic-fluid statement, isotropy or FLRW proof, family or geometry claim, native-transfer claim, observational inference, HTT posterior/evidence, MIO truth claim, or public-use promotion blocks the card.
